**Serial hardware:** the stock Tandy Modempak (a ROM cartridge, obsolete by the mid-1990s) has a built-in 300-baud modem and RS-232 port with no hardware handshaking - any modem speed above 9.6K baud needs handshaking support the Modempak's port doesn't provide, so upgrading just the modem chip doesn't help. The separate RS-232 Pak (harder to find than the Modempak) supports up to 14.4K baud for modem use and 19.2K for a direct terminal connection.
